gradient.gradient-sky: radial-gradient(75% 120% at 6% 4%, #9EA7D8 0%, transparent 58%), radial-gradient(65% 110% at 96% 0%, #E9D294 0%, transparent 62%), radial-gradient(85% 130% at 78% 100%, #C48B75 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(70% 120% at 22% 104%, #A18593 0%, transparent 62%), radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 40%, #DFA670 0%, transparent 70%), linear-gradient(140deg, #9EA7D8, #DFA670)
gradient.gradient-warm: radial-gradient(80% 140% at 0% 0%, #E9D294 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(90% 140% at 100% 100%, #A18593 0%, transparent 62%), linear-gradient(120deg, #DFA670, #C48B75)
gradient.gradient-soft: radial-gradient(90% 140% at 0% 0%, #EAE0CE 0%, transparent 65%), radial-gradient(80% 130% at 100% 20%, rgba(247, 214, 127, 0.35) 0%, transparent 60%), linear-gradient(160deg, #F7F1E5, #EFE7D9)

font.serif: "Source Serif 4", "Iowan Old Style", Palatino, Georgia, serif
